result:
The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's at step 12. The Orchestrator asked it to explore the USGS species page, including the occurrence data. It only "clicked the control" and returned the same top-of-page view, never scrolling to the Nonindigenous Occurrences table that lists the earliest observation year by state. Without that data, the run hit a content-filter error and ended with an unsupported guess of 1976 instead of 1954.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 12
